findings.title: Insult aimed at a group
findings.detail: Under your real name, calling people idiots who deserve an outage can read as contempt rather than a joke, especially to colleagues who see it without the thread. The point about Friday releases stands without it.
findings.text: Honestly, anyone still shipping on Fridays is an idiot and deserves the outage. Do better.
